description: Implement React Error Boundary system with GlobalErrorBoundary, RouteErrorBoundary, and ComponentErrorBoundary components. These boundaries will catch JavaScript errors in React components and prevent the entire application from crashing, showing fallback UI instead. Based on codebase exploration, the app currently has no error boundaries despite being a complex multi-role system.
steps: Create GlobalErrorBoundary class component in src/components/errors/GlobalErrorBoundary.tsx with comprehensive error catching, logging, and user-friendly fallback UI with restart options
Create RouteErrorBoundary functional component in src/components/errors/RouteErrorBoundary.tsx using react-error-boundary library for route-specific error handling with navigation fallbacks
Create ComponentErrorBoundary in src/components/errors/ComponentErrorBoundary.tsx for wrapping individual complex components like data tables and forms
Create reusable ErrorFallback component in src/components/errors/ErrorFallback.tsx with different variants (page-level, component-level) and recovery actions
Modify src/app/layout.tsx to wrap the entire app with GlobalErrorBoundary, integrating with existing AuthProvider and NotificationProvider structure
Add react-error-boundary dependency to package.json for modern error boundary utilities
acceptance_criteria: JavaScript errors in React components no longer crash the entire application
Users see helpful error messages with recovery options instead of blank screens
Error boundaries integrate with existing notification system in NotificationContext
Development mode shows detailed error information while production shows user-friendly messages
GlobalErrorBoundary provides restart and navigation options to recover from errors
verification: npm run build completes successfully with new error boundary components
npm run type-check passes without TypeScript errors
Manual testing: Create test component that throws error, verify error boundary catches it and shows fallback UI
Manual testing: Verify error boundaries don't interfere with normal app functionality
